Reassess test programs after HW audit is complete

After the VHDL hardware audit is finished, re-run all test programs on both the hardware and simulator to verify correctness. The test programs were written for correct ISA behavior — do NOT modify them to match simulator quirks.

Test programs to reassess:
- test_branches: BZ.T/BZ.N, loops (J+BZ), BHLEQ (uses LHH/LHL/LLH/LLL)
- test_memory: SW/LW roundtrip, offsets, address arithmetic
- test_shifts: SHL, SHR, SAR, ROL, ROR
- test_hilo: LHI/LLO, MFHI/MFLO, MTHI/MTLO, MUL, AIS
- test_subroutine: JAL/JR, nested calls, return address
- test_fibonacci: Loop with J+BZ, memory store
- test_sort: Bubble sort (nested loops, LW/SW, SGT, BZ)

Known issues to cross-check with HW:
- SAR on negative numbers (0xFF00 >> 4 gives 0x0FF0, expected 0xFFF0)
- MFHI/MFLO/LHI/LLO timing and forwarding
- BHLEQ with LHH/LHL/LLH/LLL instruction sequence
- Subroutine return address convention (JAL saves savedpc+1)
- Forwarding gaps (decode_to_exec not checked)
- NOP requirements between dependent register operations

Blocked by: HW audit completion
